'''''Rhytidiadelphus''''' is a genus of [[moss]]es belonging to the family [[Hylocomiaceae]].<ref name="IRMNG">{{cite web |title=IRMNG - Rhytidiadelphus (Limpricht) Warnstorf, 1906 |url=https://www.irmng.org/aphia.php?p=taxdetails&id=1095863 |website=www.irmng.org |access-date=24 January 2021}}</ref>

The genus was [[species description|first described]] by [[Karl Gustav Limpricht]] in 1906.<ref name="IRMNG" />

The genus has [[cosmopolitan distribution]].<ref name="GBIF">{{cite web |title=Rhytidiadelphus (Limpr.) Warnst. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/2679706 |website=www.gbif.org |access-date=24 January 2021 |language=en}}</ref>

Species:
* ''[[Rhytidiadelphus japonicus]]'' T. Koponen, 1971<ref name="IRMNG" />
* ''[[Rhytidiadelphus loreus]]'' Warnstorf, 1906<ref name="IRMNG" />
* ''[[Rhytidiadelphus printzii]]'' Kaalaas, 1919<ref name="IRMNG" />
* ''[[Rhytidiadelphus squarrosus]]'' Warnstorf, 1906<ref name="IRMNG" />
* ''[[Rhytidiadelphus triquetrus]]'' Warnstorf, 1906<ref name="IRMNG" />
